name: meridian-e2e
description: Playwright E2E debugging harness for the MERIDIAN /v3 frontend. Runs OUT of process against a live (:8000) or sandboxed (:8010) engine - it never starts or stops an engine itself. Deliberately its own package: frontend/ is a BUILD-ONLY workspace and must stay that way. Not collected by pytest (pyproject testpaths=['tests']).
